meta.title: Excalicast — Whiteboard Recorder
meta.description: Record whiteboard activity + mic audio. One take, exported to multiple aspect ratios.

hero.badge: Runs in your browser · no signup
hero.subtitle: Excalicast is a browser-based whiteboard recorder. Draw in Excalidraw, capture voice and actions, then export 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:5 MP4s — ready for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and more.
hero.disclaimer: Recording is free · watermarked MP4 export is free · $9.99 per recording to unlock watermark-free export

lossless.title: Lossless capture
lossless.desc: Captures the operation stream rather than screen pixels. Always crisp, never affected by window occlusion or minimization.

audio.title: Synchronized voice
audio.desc: Mic audio is tightly aligned with whiteboard actions. Exported MP4 includes a full audio track.

ratios.title: One take, every ratio
ratios.desc: From the same recording, export landscape, portrait, square, and 4:5 versions. No re-recording.

local.title: Local rendering
local.desc: Videos render in the browser via ffmpeg.wasm. Raw recordings never leave your computer.

camera.title: Optional camera bubble
camera.desc: Toggle the camera on for a draggable circular bubble overlay — great for teaching scenarios.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.desc: Recordings live in your browser (IndexedDB). The server only stores payment records and never touches your recordings.

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.subheading: Recording and watermarked export are free. Pay per recording when you need watermark-free export.

free.label: Free
free.tagline: No signup. Just open the app.

oneTime.label: One-time unlock
oneTime.tagline: Permanent unlock for this recording. No account required.
oneTime.bullet3: Re-export this recording into any ratio, watermark-free, as many times as you want
oneTime.bullet4: Secure Paddle checkout (cards / Apple Pay / Google Pay)
oneTime.bullet5: Recording data stays in your browser. Server only stores payment status.

pricing.methods: Accepted payment methods: Visa · Mastercard · American Express · Apple Pay · Google Pay
pricing.processedBy: All transactions are processed by <paddle>Paddle</paddle>. Excalicast never sees your payment details.

step1.title: Record
step1.desc: Click "Start recording." Draw, write, and narrate on the whiteboard. Optionally enable the camera bubble.

step2.title: Preview
step2.desc: When you stop, you jump to the export page. Pick your target ratio (16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:5).

step3.title: Download
step3.desc: Click "Download" for a watermarked MP4. Or pay $9.99 to permanently unlock watermark-free export of this recording.

refund.heading: Refund policy
refund.body: If you can't export a watermark-free MP4 after paying, or you're unsatisfied with the service, you can request a full refund within 14 days of purchase. Email support@excalicast.cn and we'll respond within 2 business days.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions, feedback, partnership, or refund requests — email us. We reply within 2 business days.

legal.questionsCta: Still have questions? Drop us a line.
